_meta.description: Independent walk-forward simulation of the three pre-registered candidate models on committed vendor daily bars. NOT a TradingView Strategy Report result, NOT a Paper Trading account result, NOT a prediction or recommendation.
_meta.test_protocol: research/strategy/testing-plan.md (T2 walk-forward, T3 costs, T4 metrics, T5 verdicts)

moderate.label: commission $1.50/contract/side + slippage 5% of ATR(14) per leg

high.label: commission $2.50/contract/side + slippage 10% of ATR(14) per leg

sizing_models.compounding: qty = min(cap, floor(equity x 20 / notional)) with running equity
sizing_models.initial_fixed: same, but sizing equity fixed at the 250,000 start balance

assumptions: Signals on bar close fill at the next bar's open (Pine broker-emulator default).
End-of-window open positions close at the final bar's close (contest auto-close analog).
Whole contracts; position size min(rules cap, buying power); no pyramiding.
No margin-call liquidation simulated; margin breaches are counted, not acted on.
Slippage is a declared fraction of signal-bar ATR(14) on both legs; commissions per side.
Vendor series are front-month continuous futures with unadjusted rolls; roll gaps can create artificial signals.
